BASELINE-SEMANTICS MERGE NOTE (the work order's Lead path): a TRUE baseline — a plain single-model execution planned on request — needs baseline planning semantics the frozen public create contract does not carry. The delivered launcher never widens the vocabulary: it re-submits the SAME composed task through the SAME frozen create contract carrying only the lineage metadata the platform records (metadata.baseline=single-model-baseline-requested, metadata.baselineOf=source run), so the platform still plans the new run under its own governed strategy selection. The missing contract is NAMED in the surface (BASELINE_MISSING_CONTRACT: a create-contract extension carrying baseline planning semantics, e.g. a planning.baseline request vocabulary) and renders as the honest unavailable state. If the platform later adds baseline planning semantics, that is a public-contract decision for the Lead — this console order neither implements nor blocks it.

The baseline lineage vocabulary is recorded metadata, never a planning override: provider/model selection is structurally impossible in the frozen create contract (D12's mutation-vocabulary pin plus the launcher's captured-request-keys proof). The compare renders lineage chips from the records (baselineLineageOf is the single reader).
